edge-monitor-bot: ALERT: sudden spike -> ~9M req/hr hitting /v1/embeddings from ~120k unique IPs, mix of HTTP probes + UDP reflection signatures. top ASN 45678. ingress queue growth + proxy conn churn.
elllen (oncall): ack. triaging now — is traffic causing customer errors or just higher latency?
sanjay (eng-infra): p95 latency up on embeddings, origin 503s from pool exhaustion. Autoscale struggling due to many short-lived conns. Plan: 1) temp conn-limit per IP on edge 2) aggressive timeout 3) block known reflection ports at edge (UDP 123/19). Also preparing ipset by ASN.
maria (sec): agree. immediate mitigation suggestions: add WAF rule to drop UDP reflection payloads, enforce per-ASN rate-limits for embeddings, reduce keepalive for websocket fanout. IMPORTANT: any RBAC changes for ipset or firewall must be logged with justification. @ops-bot snapshot RBAC + KMS activity now. :lock: :mag: 
ops-bot: Executing runbook step: applied conn-limit 30 per IP to front proxy, closed UDP 123 at edge, deployed WAF rule id `ddos-1981-01` (blocking NTP-like payload patterns), created ipset `abuse-asn-45678`.
ellen (oncall): nice fast moves. any rotation or sensitive key touches?
kms-team: no rotations performed. Observed spike in KMS decrypts for service account `redwood/embeddings-cache` (cache churn). Recommend enabling KMS audit logs for the key for 90d and an alert on >5x baseline decrypt rate.
maria (sec): we briefly granted a temporary RBAC exception to infra team for ipset updates (ttl 24h). Please ensure who/why is recorded in audit log and revert automatically. We should also capture the exact commands run.
jim (comms): Do we have customer impact to post on status? any regions worse?
sanjay (eng-infra): impact low-medium: a few regions saw 1-3% 503s for ~15m during spike start, then improved after conn-limit. No SLA breach yet.
jim (comms): Drafting status: "We observed elevated abusive traffic targeting embeddings endpoints. Mitigations applied; no data exposure. Customers may have seen transient errors." Will share for review.
devex (docs): adding quick runbook snippet for ASN blocking + verification:
```
# add ip to set
ipset add abuse-asn-45678 203.0.113.5
# verify proxy health
curl -sS https://edge.health/_/metrics | grep embeddings_pool
```
sanjay (eng-infra): post-incident action items (short):
- detection rule for sudden ASN-concentrated spikes -> owner: sanjay
- per-tenant / per-token rate-limits for embeddings/stream -> owner: sanjay
- RBAC emergency procedure doc + auto-revert exceptions -> owner: maria
- enable/retain KMS audit logs; correlate with cache churn -> owner: kms-team
- comms follow-up + status page update -> owner: jim
- runbook PR for ipset/waf snippets -> owner: devex
maria (sec): also add an automated test that simulates high-unique-ip fanout to ensure autoscale and connection limits behave within SLO.
ellen (oncall): thanks. i'll keep this thread open until runbook PR + detection rule merged. please post PR links here. :white_check_mark: 
edge-monitor-bot: NOTE: follow-up detection rule created draft `detect/asn_spike_embeddings` (WIP) and saved as ticket #INC-1981.
ellen (oncall): closing loop after owners confirm. if anyone makes further RBAC or KMS changes, tag this thread and include the audit id.
